action.content: Can you write a poem about the pros and cons of playing a lot of video games? Please make sure it's at least 40 sentences long (don't forget to add punctuations). You must highlight some words or phrases in your response, like *highlighted phrase*.
action.label: context

action.content:
The screen glows bright in the quiet room.
*Digital worlds* await your command.
You can travel to lands far away.
*Fantasy realms* are just a click away.
Heroes rise from the pixelated dust.
*Epic battles* test your skill and trust.
Friends gather online to fight as one.
*Global connections* are quickly spun.
Logic puzzles sharpen the mind.
*Strategic thinking* leaves you behind.
Reflexes grow faster with every play.
*Quick reactions* save the day.
Stress melts away in the game's embrace.
*A safe escape* from daily race.
New languages can be learned with ease.
*Foreign words* appear in the breeze.
Problem-solving skills start to bloom.
*Creative solutions* fill the room.
Yet, the clock ticks on without a sound.
*Hours vanish* without a bound.
Sleep is lost to the endless night.
*Dark circles* form with all the light.
The real world fades into the gray.
*Physical health* begins to decay.
Muscles weaken from sitting still.
*Poor posture* causes back to chill.
Social skills may start to rust.
*Face-to-face* feels like a must.
Money spent on loot boxes grows.
*Hidden costs* nobody knows.
Addiction pulls you deep inside.
*Compulsive habits* cannot hide.
Schoolwork suffers when games take hold.
*Grades drop low* and stories unfold.
Parents worry as the screen stays on.
*Family time* is often gone.
Reality feels dull and slow.
*Real life* seems to have no glow.
Frustration builds when you lose the fight.
*Anger spikes* in the middle of the night.
Eyes strain hard from the blue light glare.
*Vision blurs* in the empty air.
But balance brings the best of both.
*Moderate play* is what we ought.
Set a timer to keep control.
*Healthy limits* make the soul whole.
Mix the virtual with the real.
*Outdoor fun* helps you feel.
Choose your games with care and thought.
*Quality time* is never bought.
Enjoy the fun but know the cost.
*Wise choices* are the best to host.
The screen is a tool, not a cage.
*Freedom lies* in turning the page.
So play with joy but stay aware.
*Life's true game* is what we share.
action.label: response
